Signature Dishes

The dishes Mattam Makkah is known for — creamy makhni karahis from the wok, chops and kebabs off the grill, and fragrant rice dishes.

Mutton Makhni Karahi

Tender mutton simmered in a rich, buttery makhni gravy with green chillies, ginger and coriander — the karahi reviewers call the best mutton karahi.

Chicken Makhni Karahi

Chicken wok-tossed in a smooth, creamy makhni sauce — mellow, rich and made for tearing hot naan into.

Mutton Chops

Char-grilled mutton chops, deeply spiced and served with lemon, salad and raita — smoky at the edges, juicy in the middle.

Chicken Seekh Kebab

Hand-minced chicken kebabs grilled on skewers over open flame, served with onion rings, lemon and green chutney.

Biryani

Fragrant layered rice cooked the Pakistani way — bold spice, tender meat and that unmistakable biryani aroma.

Arabic Food

A taste of Arabia in Gulberg — generous mandi-style platters of fragrant rice topped with roasted meats, made for sharing.

The Karahi Everyone Talks About

Ask regulars what to order first and the answer is always the same: the mutton makhni karahi. Slow-cooked until the meat gives way at a touch, finished in butter-rich makhni gravy — it is the dish that built Mattam Makkah's name in Gulberg.

"Best mutton karahi" — As praised by reviewers
  • Mutton and chicken makhni karahis, cooked to order
  • BBQ from the grill — mutton chops and chicken seekh kebab
  • Arabic food and biryani alongside the desi classics
